'''Rainbow trout''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found in [[temperate]] [[water|freshwater]] [[river]]s and [[lake]]s year-round. They are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] rainbow trout for their ''coloration''.
